title: CircuTutor: Transforming Static Circuit Problems into Intelligent and Dynamic Tutoring
abstract: arXiv:2609.08254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning direct current circuit concepts requires learners to connect invisible physical quantities, such as current, voltage, resistance, and power, with observable outcomes such as bulb brightness. Conventional textbook materials and general-purpose circuit simulators provide opportunities for problem solving and exploration but offer limited support for explaining why circuit behavior changes or diagnosing the reasoning behind incorrect answers. We present CircuTutor, a circuit-state-driven intelligent tutoring system that transforms static textbook circuit problems into an interactive tutoring workflow. translated_title: CircuTutor：将静态电路问题转化为智能动态辅导
translated_abstract: 学习直流电路概念需要学习者将不可见的物理量（如电流、电压、电阻和功率）与可观察的结果（如灯泡亮度）联系起来。传统的教科书材料和通用电路仿真器为解题和探索提供了机会，但在解释电路行为为何发生变化或诊断错误答案背后的推理方面支持有限。我们提出了CircuTutor，这是一个由电路状态驱动的智能辅导系统，能够将静态的教科书电路问题转化为交互式辅导工作流程。CircuTutor首先使用多模态问题解析来提取教科书中的问题、电路拓扑结构、元件参数、开关状态和答案选项，并将其转换为结构化任务，同时通过电路仿真进行验证。随后，学习者可以交互式地探索电路（通过改变参数）并提交答案。
tldr: CircuTutor是一个电路状态驱动的智能辅导系统，通过多模态解析将静态教科书电路问题转化为交互式动态辅导，帮助学习者深入理解电路概念并诊断解题背后的推理。
en_tdlr: CircuTutor is a circuit-state-driven intelligent tutoring system that transforms static textbook circuit problems into interactive dynamic tutoring through multimodal parsing, helping learners deeply understand circuit concepts and diagnose the reasoning behind their answers.
